results.name: gif
notes: Real desktop BitBlt capture of a controlled 1280x720 animated pattern; SRCCOPY without CAPTUREBLT, full opaque GIF frames, 30/30/40 ms delay cycle.
Before each sample, the harness reasserts HWND_TOPMOST without activation to keep its test pattern above ordinary topmost windows. A failed RGB sample is never retried.
Every captured frame matches the displayed source pattern; every decoded WIC frame is checked against its captured RGB hash. WIC validates decoding, not browser/Photos playback.

Harness costs are reported separately: pattern generation/painting, GdiFlush+DwmFlush presentation wait, RGB verification, and file writes. The drop count measures this complete sequential experiment, not a production recorder. Use capture_plus_encode plus the independent capture spike to assess the acquisition bottleneck.

P0 uses one UI/capture/encode thread and one pending compressed frame. P5 still needs parallel encoding, changed rectangles, transparency, cursor capture, backpressure, lock-screen pause, and preview UI. Wu fallback is unit-tested; this <=8-color workload exercises exact palettes.
AC0-6 no-drop target is not met by the sequential prototype. Use these timings to budget P5 worker parallelism; preserved GIF duration does not hide dropped ticks.
